title: Citrix security advisory (AV26-833)
description: As of August 19, 2026, NetScaler is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
NetScaler ADC and NetScaler
	Version 13.1 prior to or equal to 13.1-63.21
Version 14.1 prior to or equal to 14.1-73.32
Version 13.1 prior to or equal to 13.1-63.21
Version 14.1 prior to or equal to 14.1-73.32

NetScaler ADC FIPS
	Prior to 14.1-73.32 FIPS

NetScaler ADC FIPS and NDcPP
	Prior to 13.1-37.277
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
